name: Offsight
tagline: Offsites that don't die in a shared spreadsheet
positioning: Usage-based offsite operations for enterprise teams — venues, logistics, and agendas that survive contact with 200 attendees.

hero.h1: Offsites your VPs will actually show up to
hero.sub: Book venues, wrangle 200 flights, and lock the agenda from one console. Then pay for the offsites you actually run — not the seats you guessed at in Q1.

features.title: Venue search that isn't a group chat
features.description: Filter 4,000+ vetted venues by headcount, A/V, and 'will the CFO complain.' Hold dates without a deposit and book in the same tab.

features.title: Travel that reconciles itself
features.description: Attendees book flights and rooms inside policy. Every itinerary maps to a cost center, so finance stops emailing you at 11pm.

features.title: Agendas people can read
features.description: Drag sessions onto a shared timeline, assign owners, and publish a mobile schedule. No more PDF-that-changed-Tuesday.

features.title: Live headcount, live budget
features.description: Watch RSVPs, dietary flags, and spend update in real time. Export the whole thing to your ERP with one boring click.

features.title: Vendor payments in one ledger
features.description: Caterers, buses, and that improv troupe someone insisted on — invoiced, approved, and paid from a single trail.

features.title: Security won't hate you
features.description: SSO, SCIM, and per-event data retention. Attendee PII expires when the offsite does, not three audits later.

testimonials.quote: We ran four regional offsites in one quarter and I didn't touch a single spreadsheet. My old process was a spreadsheet, a prayer, and a Slack channel called '#offsite-help-me'.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

testimonials.quote: The usage billing sold our CFO instantly. We stopped paying for a platform that sat idle nine months a year and only got charged for the offsites we actually ran.
testimonials.name: Daniel Reyes

testimonials.quote: Two hundred engineers, three cities, one weekend. Offsight caught a double-booked ballroom before I did. That alone paid for the year.
testimonials.name: Marta Kovac

pricing.blurb: Run your first offsite and pay only per attendee-day.
For teams running offsites across regions all year.
Global programs with procurement in the room.

homepage.footerBlurb: Offsight is offsite operations software for enterprises that got tired of running company retreats out of a shared drive.
